chapters.goal: Gather 10 Hope. Tap the void; discover Elpis for 5 Hope.
chapters.lore: There was nothing. Yet you hoped something could be.
chapters.title: 01 / Nothing but hope

chapters.goal: Discover Elpis / Possibility Fluctuation. Hope and Duality
chapters.lore: A first fairy gathers the hope that something could exist.
chapters.title: 02 / Elpis awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Votia / First Intention. Hope and Duality
chapters.lore: Possibility becomes a wish with a direction: let there be something.
chapters.title: 03 / Votia awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Aeria / Primordial Breath. Hope and Duality
chapters.lore: A breath of fantasy essence ripples through the silent void.
chapters.title: 04 / Aeria awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Yuelin / Yin Sanctuary. Hope and Duality
chapters.lore: A lunar fairy tends stillness, shelter, and the power to receive.
chapters.title: 05 / Yuelin awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Riyara / Yang Radiance. Hope and Duality
chapters.lore: A solar fairy awakens motion, warmth, and the power to express.
chapters.title: 06 / Riyara awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Lianghua / Duality Dimension. Hope and Duality
chapters.lore: Neither side conquers the other. Build a dimension where receiving and expressing sustain one another.
chapters.title: 07 / Build Duality Dimension

chapters.goal: Build Lady Sylvara / Wood Dimension. Five Elements
chapters.lore: Build the dimension of branching and growth; its living patterns can permeate any world.
chapters.title: 08 / Build Wood Dimension

chapters.goal: Build Lady Ignis / Fire Dimension. Five Elements
chapters.lore: Build the dimension of warmth and transformation, a domain rather than a single flame.
chapters.title: 09 / Build Fire Dimension

chapters.goal: Build Lady Terrielle / Earth Dimension. Five Elements
chapters.lore: Build the dimension of grounding and endurance, where forms find a center.
chapters.title: 10 / Build Earth Dimension

chapters.goal: Build Lady Argentia / Metal Dimension. Five Elements
chapters.lore: Build the dimension of pattern, boundaries, and refinement.
chapters.title: 11 / Build Metal Dimension

chapters.goal: Build Lady Mizuelle / Water Dimension. Five Elements
chapters.lore: Build the dimension of flow, adaptation, and memory.
chapters.title: 12 / Build Water Dimension

chapters.goal: Build Lady Wuxielle / Interwoven Elemental Dimension. Five Elements
chapters.lore: Join the five elemental dimensions in a cycle of nourishment and restraint. Their domains remain distinct and interdependent.
chapters.title: 13 / Build Interwoven Elemental Dimension

chapters.goal: Discover Tickelle / First Moment. Time
chapters.lore: The time fairy separates what is from what might come next.
chapters.title: 14 / Tickelle awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Chronaria / Time Dimension. Time
chapters.lore: Build a dimension of succession and duration. Time need not precede space in every creation; this is the order of your unfolding.
chapters.title: 15 / Build Time Dimension

chapters.goal: Discover Puntia / First Somewhere. Space
chapters.lore: A fairy marks a place in a void that never had a here.
chapters.title: 16 / Puntia awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Dimensia / Space Dimension. Space
chapters.lore: Build a dimension of distance and direction. Space is one supporting domain of existence, not a higher rank than time.
chapters.title: 17 / Build Space Dimension

chapters.goal: Discover Continuelle / Spacetime Tapestry. Causal Weave
chapters.lore: The fairies of time and space weave a stage for every future event.
chapters.title: 18 / Continuelle awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Causalia / Causal Dimension. Causal Weave
chapters.lore: Build the dimension of relationships between events. Interweave time and space without consuming either domain.
chapters.title: 19 / Build Causal Dimension

chapters.goal: Discover Foamelle / Dreaming Quantum Sea. Quantum Foundations
chapters.lore: In this fictional cosmology, speculative fluctuations become a nursery of particles.
chapters.title: 20 / Foamelle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Quira / Quark Filament. Quantum Foundations
chapters.lore: Tiny particle fairies weave the first threads of matter.
chapters.title: 21 / Quira awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Electra / Electron Song. Quantum Foundations
chapters.lore: A bright companion brings charge and the promise of bonds.
chapters.title: 22 / Electra awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Athelia / Quantum Dimension. Quantum Foundations
chapters.lore: Build the quantum dimension of this fantasy: possibilities and particle patterns underlie matter, but can be woven into an already existing world.
chapters.title: 23 / Build Quantum Dimension

chapters.goal: Discover Bondelle / Molecular Promise. Matter and Stars
chapters.lore: Atoms learn to stay together and become something more.
chapters.title: 24 / Bondelle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Nebelle / Molecular Nebula Cloud. Matter and Stars
chapters.lore: A violet fairy cradles dust and gas in luminous veils.
chapters.title: 25 / Nebelle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Gravielle / Gravity Lullaby. Matter and Stars
chapters.lore: A gentle pull gathers the scattered into a shared embrace.
chapters.title: 26 / Gravielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Solara / Stellar Ignition. Matter and Stars
chapters.lore: A sun fairy kindles the first lasting light.
chapters.title: 27 / Solara awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Astrelle / Stellar Dimension. Matter and Stars
chapters.lore: Build a dimension of stellar light and matter. It shares foundations with quantum, elemental, temporal, and spatial domains.
chapters.title: 28 / Build Stellar Dimension

chapters.goal: Discover Petralia / Worldseed Crust. Worlds and Spirit
chapters.lore: A patient fairy shapes a rocky place beneath the stars.
chapters.title: 29 / Petralia awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Marielle / Ocean Dream. Worlds and Spirit
chapters.lore: Water fairies fill the lowlands with a shimmering blue home.
chapters.title: 30 / Marielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Caelia / Sky Veil. Worlds and Spirit
chapters.lore: A breath of sky shelters the world and softens its light.
chapters.title: 31 / Caelia awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Florielle / Living Biosphere. Worlds and Spirit
chapters.lore: A green fairy tends the first heartbeat. In this world's myth, even small life carries the whole divine nature, not yet perceived.
chapters.title: 32 / Florielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Lunaria / Moon and Tides. Worlds and Spirit
chapters.lore: A moon fairy gives the oceans a rhythm to follow.
chapters.title: 33 / Lunaria awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Verielle / Wheel of Seasons. Worlds and Spirit
chapters.lore: Growth, warmth, harvest, and rest become a turning garden.
chapters.title: 34 / Verielle awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Animelle / Soul Dimension. Worlds and Spirit
chapters.lore: Build a dimension of living awareness. Every small life already carries the divine nature, though it perceives itself as separate.
chapters.title: 35 / Build Soul Dimension

chapters.goal: Discover Stellaria / Constellation Covenant. Living Universe
chapters.lore: Star fairies trace stories between distant lights.
chapters.title: 36 / Stellaria awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Nyxara / Galactic Heart. Living Universe
chapters.lore: A gravity fairy anchors an island of stars around a dark heart.
chapters.title: 37 / Nyxara awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Galaxia / Galactic Web. Living Universe
chapters.lore: Galaxy fairies link their islands into a great shining tapestry.
chapters.title: 38 / Galaxia awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Universa / Living Universe Dimension. Living Universe
chapters.lore: Build the living universe we know within the story: stars, worlds, and life woven across many supporting dimensions, never a solitary container.
chapters.title: 39 / Build Living Universe Dimension

chapters.goal: Discover Mirielle / Daughter Universe. Universe and Beyond
chapters.lore: The first universe becomes the cradle of another beginning.
chapters.title: 40 / Mirielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Futura / Branching Timeline Tree. Universe and Beyond
chapters.lore: The time fairy tends histories that could have unfolded differently.
chapters.title: 41 / Futura awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Polyra / Multiverse Loom. Universe and Beyond
chapters.lore: A weaving fairy joins many universes into a family of possibilities.
chapters.title: 42 / Polyra awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Nomielle / Possible Laws Dimension. Universe and Beyond
chapters.lore: Build a dimension where different universes may sustain different rules. Omnielle hears a chorus that no single lawbook can contain.
chapters.title: 43 / Build Possible Laws Dimension

chapters.goal: Discover Infinitelle / A Chorus Without Last World. Omnielle's Universe Confluence
chapters.lore: Omnielle hears no final universe beyond the next: existence holds infinitely many worlds, not a row of spheres waiting at distant coordinates.
chapters.title: 44 / Infinitelle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Superielle / Superposed Universes. Omnielle's Universe Confluence
chapters.lore: Worlds overlap as distinct possibilities in the confluence. In this fantasy, sharing a presence does not force them into one history or one material place.
chapters.title: 45 / Superielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Achronelle / A Thousand Incompatible Nows. Omnielle's Universe Confluence
chapters.lore: One world counts ages, another circles its moments, another has no succession. Omnielle cannot ask which universe is first without choosing a local clock.
chapters.title: 46 / Achronelle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Aporielle / Where Distance Has No Common Meaning. Omnielle's Universe Confluence
chapters.lore: Universes are not neighboring rooms in a larger space. Near and far belong to each world; their confluence needs no shared map and no journey through the gap.
chapters.title: 47 / Aporielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Heterielle / Laws That Need Not Agree. Omnielle's Universe Confluence
chapters.lore: A law can hold faithfully within one universe and have no meaning in another. Their meeting is not permission to break local rules; it is the absence of one universal rulebook.
chapters.title: 48 / Heterielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Resonielle / Resonance Without Travel. Omnielle's Universe Confluence
chapters.lore: Omnielle teaches the fairies to answer a shared motif without measuring a route or synchronized moment. This is a fictional relationship, not a claim of faster-than-light signaling.
chapters.title: 49 / Resonielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Coexielle / The Uncollapsed Garden. Omnielle's Universe Confluence
chapters.lore: Recognition does not select one universe and erase the rest. Worlds remain distinct possibilities held together; no single observer owns their existence.
chapters.title: 50 / Coexielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Accordielle / Concord Without Erasure. Omnielle's Universe Confluence
chapters.lore: The fairies prepare Omnielle's foundation: connection without conquest, coexistence without sameness, and care for lives whose worlds may never share a sky.
chapters.title: 51 / Accordielle awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Omnielle / Omniverse Confluence Dimension. Omnielle's Universe Confluence
chapters.lore: Omnielle builds a confluence of infinitely many superposed universes. No shared clock, common distance, or single causal law governs their meeting. She shelters their relationships without collapsing their differences; every living world retains its own story.
chapters.title: 52 / Build Omniverse Confluence Dimension

chapters.goal: Discover Daolia / First Dao Seed. Three Thousand Dao
chapters.lore: A fairy nurtures a way existence can unfold: neither a command nor a superior realm, but one living principle.
chapters.title: 53 / Daolia awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Taorielle / Garden of Innumerable Ways. Three Thousand Dao
chapters.lore: Ways of growth, stillness, dream, sound, renewal, and countless other principles blossom as distinct potential dimensions.
chapters.title: 54 / Taorielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Concordia / Concord of Different Ways. Three Thousand Dao
chapters.lore: The ways learn to coexist without becoming identical. Each dimension may be woven before or after another in a different creation sequence.
chapters.title: 55 / Concordia awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Daomielle / Three Thousand Dao Dimensions. Three Thousand Dao
chapters.lore: Build an interwoven family of three thousand Dao-like dimensions. In this original fantasy, the name evokes abundant ways of existence, not a canonical list of spiritual teachings.
chapters.title: 56 / Build Three Thousand Dao Dimensions

chapters.goal: Build Lady Aletheia / Reality Dimension. Reality
chapters.lore: Build a dimension that lets possible worlds become actual. Reality rests on many interwoven dimensions; later foundations can support earlier creations.
chapters.title: 57 / Build Reality Dimension

chapters.goal: Discover Memorielle / Memory in Every Seed. Life Remembers
chapters.lore: In this story, every living seed carries the whole divine nature, still unrecognized. Life did not lack divinity; it lacked awareness of its depth.
chapters.title: 58 / Memorielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Respiria / One Breath, Many Lives. Life Remembers
chapters.lore: A thousand lives seem separate, yet their fairy hears one breath expressed through many voices.
chapters.title: 59 / Respiria awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Testielle / The Inner Witness. Life Remembers
chapters.lore: The fairy of witnessing turns inward: the one who observes is also part of what is observed.
chapters.title: 60 / Testielle awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Veloria / Perception Dimension. Life Remembers
chapters.lore: Build the dimension of perception. Local senses are a viewpoint, not the boundary of life; the whole was never absent.
chapters.title: 61 / Build Perception Dimension

chapters.goal: Discover Panoria / All-Seeing Awareness. Divine Recognition
chapters.lore: All-seeing is not surveillance from above. The life within every viewpoint recognizes its shared sight.
chapters.title: 62 / Panoria awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Praeselia / Presence Without Distance. Divine Recognition
chapters.lore: Before the journey between two places, the same living presence is already at both ends.
chapters.title: 63 / Praeselia awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Ubielle / Everywhere Is Within. Divine Recognition
chapters.lore: The fairy of nearness loosens the imagined border between a life and the reality it inhabits.
chapters.title: 64 / Ubielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Omnipra / Omnipresence Recognized. Divine Recognition
chapters.lore: Life recognizes itself throughout existence. It has not traveled everywhere; in this fantasy, separation was the veil.
chapters.title: 65 / Omnipra awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Volunielle / Will That Nurtures. Divine Recognition
chapters.lore: Creative will awakens as care, not domination. To be powerful is to make room for another beginning.
chapters.title: 66 / Volunielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Posselia / The Unbounded Possible. Divine Recognition
chapters.lore: Life can imagine beyond the laws of a single reality. Possibility becomes an open garden.
chapters.title: 67 / Posselia awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Omnipotelle / Omnipotence Recognized. Divine Recognition
chapters.lore: Ultimate creative power is recognized as life's own nature. In the game's myth, it was latent in the smallest seed.
chapters.title: 68 / Omnipotelle awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Sophielle / Divine Awareness Dimension. Divine Recognition
chapters.lore: Build a dimension uniting all-seeing understanding, omnipresence, and creative power. Recognition reveals life's latent nature rather than granting it from outside.
chapters.title: 69 / Build Divine Awareness Dimension

chapters.goal: Discover Carielle / The Whole That Cherishes Each. Living Divinity
chapters.lore: Unity does not erase anyone. The fairy of compassion protects every distinct voice within the shared life.
chapters.title: 70 / Carielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Vivielle / Life and Ultimate Divinity. Living Divinity
chapters.lore: The life of the first ocean recognizes the same nature as the ultimate goddess: presence, awareness, and creative power.
chapters.title: 71 / Vivielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Omnivielle / Omniall: Life Recognizes Itself. Living Divinity
chapters.lore: Omniall names the story's revelation: all-present, all-seeing, all-capable life, once hidden from its own perception.
chapters.title: 72 / Omnivielle awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Elpithia / Living Divinity Dimension. Living Divinity
chapters.lore: Build a dimension where life recognizes its shared ultimate nature. The first hope already held the whole; every distinct life remains worthy of care.
chapters.title: 73 / Build Living Divinity Dimension

chapters.goal: Discover Aurethia / Wings of the First Welcome. Dimensional Life: Angels
chapters.lore: Beyond recognized divinity, new peoples seek a home. Angelic life awakens as luminous winged beings, each free to choose a calling rather than obey a predetermined virtue.
chapters.title: 74 / Aurethia awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Canthelia / The Sanctuary Choir. Dimensional Life: Angels
chapters.lore: The angelic choirs weave healing gardens, cloudborne homes, and a covenant of refuge. Their light offers shelter, never a demand for worship.
chapters.title: 75 / Canthelia awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Seravelle / Angel Realm. Dimensional Life: Angels
chapters.lore: Build the Angel Realm, a living dimension of luminous cities and open sanctuaries. Its people sustain their own seasons, friendships, and disagreements; radiance does not make them infallible.
chapters.title: 76 / Build Angel Realm

chapters.goal: Discover Veskarra / Embers That Choose. Dimensional Life: Demons
chapters.lore: Demonic life kindles in the warm depths between dimensions. Horned artisans and ember spirits discover that fierce feeling can become creation rather than conquest.
chapters.title: 77 / Veskarra awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Cindrelle / The Freeflame Accord. Dimensional Life: Demons
chapters.lore: Forge an accord that binds promises only by willing consent. Demonic communities build hearths, foundries, and schools of transformation; no ancestry determines a life's goodness.
chapters.title: 78 / Cindrelle awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Velkaria / Demon Realm. Dimensional Life: Demons
chapters.lore: Build the Demon Realm, where obsidian gardens and ember rivers sustain passionate, self-governing peoples. Strength protects the freedom to change, including the freedom to lay power down.
chapters.title: 79 / Build Demon Realm

chapters.goal: Discover Elarwyn / Roots and Gossamer. Dimensional Life: Elves and Fairies
chapters.lore: Elves awaken within patient world-trees while fairies emerge among wandering blossoms. Different lifespans and scales of life invite listening rather than hierarchy.
chapters.title: 80 / Elarwyn awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Fayloria / The Bloomroot Covenant. Dimensional Life: Elves and Fairies
chapters.lore: Elven groves and fairy courts share seed libraries, moonlit paths, and a promise to restore what they harvest. Neither people owns the living forest.
chapters.title: 81 / Fayloria awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Sylphariel / Elves and Fairies Realm. Dimensional Life: Elves and Fairies
chapters.lore: Build the Elves and Fairies Realm: a dimension of world-tree cities, petal villages, and rivers of renewing magic. Its many courts preserve wild places and welcome lives unlike their own.
chapters.title: 82 / Build Elves and Fairies Realm

chapters.goal: Discover Theonelle / Keepers of Many Callings. Dimensional Life: Gods
chapters.lore: Distinct gods awaken as stewards of tides, thresholds, memory, and beginnings. They share life's recognized divine nature; their calling is responsibility, not greater worth than other beings.
chapters.title: 83 / Theonelle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Orathielle / The Listening Pantheon. Dimensional Life: Gods
chapters.lore: The pantheon establishes a council where even the smallest life may question a god. Worship is optional; care, accountability, and room for differing traditions sustain their gathering.
chapters.title: 84 / Orathielle awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Asteratheia / Gods Realm. Dimensional Life: Gods
chapters.lore: Build the Gods Realm, a dimension of starborne halls and gardens of living archetypes. Its gods tend connections among worlds without claiming ownership of the lives within them.
chapters.title: 85 / Build Gods Realm

chapters.goal: Discover Nymerelle / Lives Beyond the Lantern. Dimensional Life: Shadows
chapters.lore: In places unlit by other realms, shadow-born people awaken with senses tuned to hush, contrast, and hidden paths. Darkness is their habitat, not a moral sentence.
chapters.title: 86 / Nymerelle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Umbrathia / The Quiet Lantern Pact. Dimensional Life: Shadows
chapters.lore: The shadow courts protect rest, privacy, and memories not ready for daylight. Their lanterns guide invited travelers; a secret may shelter a life without imprisoning it.
chapters.title: 87 / Umbrathia awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Noctheria / Shadow Realm. Dimensional Life: Shadows
chapters.lore: Build the Shadow Realm, where velvet forests and dusk seas nurture life beyond the glare. Its borders offer refuge and chosen passage, never compulsory forgetting.
chapters.title: 88 / Build Shadow Realm

chapters.goal: Discover Pacthelia / Five Realms, Many Voices. Concord of Living Realms
chapters.lore: Angelic, demonic, elven, fairy, divine, and shadow-born envoys meet as equals. Five realms contain many peoples; no envoy can speak for every life in a homeland.
chapters.title: 89 / Pacthelia awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Liminelle / Thresholds of Welcome. Concord of Living Realms
chapters.lore: Weave invited crossings among the five living realms. Local rhythms and laws remain distinct; travelers adapt through shared care rather than forcing every home into one pattern.
chapters.title: 90 / Liminelle awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Concordielle / Concord of Living Realms Dimension. Concord of Living Realms
chapters.lore: Build a dimension of relationship among the Angel, Demon, Elves and Fairies, Gods, and Shadow realms. Their homes remain sovereign and alive: unity protects difference rather than erasing it.
chapters.title: 91 / Build Concord of Living Realms Dimension

chapters.goal: Discover Gaudielle / Joy: Creation in Bloom. Universal Emotions
chapters.lore: Across every realm, joy welcomes another beginning. In this myth, blooming gardens and gathering stars echo life's delight; no one must feel happy to deserve belonging. Claim this chapter to unlock Happy.
chapters.title: 92 / Gaudielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Lacrielle / Sorrow: What Love Remembers. Universal Emotions
chapters.lore: Oceans receive the rain as communities hold grief. Sorrow honors what mattered without demanding an ending to mourning. Creation makes room for absence as well as arrival. Claim to unlock Sorrow.
chapters.title: 93 / Lacrielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Miravelle / Wonder: The Unopened Sky. Universal Emotions
chapters.lore: A child of any realm may look upward and ask why. Wonder links the first uncertain spark to every unexplored sky; this is poetic resonance, not a physical force. Claim to unlock Surprised.
chapters.title: 94 / Miravelle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Pudorielle / Tenderness: The Trust to Be Seen. Universal Emotions
chapters.lore: A shy glance can become a bridge between strangers. Tenderness protects vulnerability across angelic choirs, shadow courts, and fairy groves without requiring anyone to reveal more than they wish. Claim to unlock Shy.
chapters.title: 95 / Pudorielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Valorelle / Courage: A Light Beside Fear. Universal Emotions
chapters.lore: Fear listens for danger; courage chooses a caring step beside it. Like a seed opening in uncertain soil, every realm learns that bravery need not silence trembling. Claim to unlock Courage.
chapters.title: 96 / Valorelle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Ardellia / Anger: The Boundary Flame. Universal Emotions
chapters.lore: Anger signals a boundary crossed. The realms learn to turn its heat toward protection and repair, never cruelty; a feeling is not a command to harm. Claim to unlock Anger.
chapters.title: 97 / Ardellia awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Empathielle / Compassion: No Heart Outside. Universal Emotions
chapters.lore: No life has to feel exactly what another feels to offer care. Compassion carries help between incompatible worlds, linking creation through chosen acts rather than erasing anyone's experience. Claim to unlock Compassion.
chapters.title: 98 / Empathielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Quieselle / Serenity: A Place for Every Feeling. Universal Emotions
chapters.lore: Stillness is not the disappearance of sorrow, anger, or joy. Like a quiet sky holding changing weather, serenity gives every feeling room without surrendering care. Claim to unlock Serenity.
chapters.title: 99 / Quieselle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Festivelle / Celebration: The Many-Hearted Dance. Universal Emotions
chapters.lore: The five realms gather in rhythms that need not agree. Their dance celebrates a creation spacious enough for delight, grief, fear, and hope together; participation is always a choice. Claim to unlock Dance.
chapters.title: 100 / Festivelle awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Cordiselle / Universal Heart Dimension. Universal Emotions
chapters.lore: Build a dimension of emotional relationship throughout creation. It holds the possibility of understanding, not one compulsory mood or a shared mind. Each heart keeps its freedom; every feeling may be heard.
chapters.title: 101 / Build Universal Heart Dimension

chapters.goal: Discover Terranielle / Human Life on Earth. Human Life and Soul Resonance
chapters.lore: On planet Earth, humans live through bodies, families, communities, and changing seasons. This fictional saga imagines that a soul might also reside in another realm at the same time; earthly life remains fully real and worthy of care.
chapters.title: 102 / Terranielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Animielle / One Life, More Than One Presence. Human Life and Soul Resonance
chapters.lore: In this game's myth, an embodied human may have a soul-presence elsewhere without departing Earth. Two homes can coexist in one life: this is simultaneous presence, not death, reincarnation, or a scientific claim about consciousness.
chapters.title: 103 / Animielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Caelielle / Earthly Life, Angelic Home. Human Life and Soul Resonance
chapters.lore: Imagine a person tending an Earth garden while their soul also resides among the Angel Realm's luminous gardens. Neither presence replaces the other; an angelic connection grants no authority over another person's choices or worth.
chapters.title: 104 / Caelielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Plurielle / Souls Across Living Realms. Human Life and Soul Resonance
chapters.lore: Other human stories imagine soul-presences in the Demon, Elves and Fairies, Gods, or Shadow realms, perhaps in more than one at once. No realm determines a human's morality, rank, or destiny, and not every person shares this belief.
chapters.title: 105 / Plurielle awakens

chapters.goal: Discover Radicielle / Rooted Here, Connected Beyond. Human Life and Soul Resonance
chapters.lore: A human may interpret dreams, imagination, or quiet reflection as symbols of connection within this story, never as proof of another realm. Food, rest, friendship, and responsibility on Earth remain important; nobody must leave or neglect their body to belong.
chapters.title: 106 / Radicielle awakens

chapters.goal: Build Lady Concordanima / Embodied Soul Dimension. Human Life and Soul Resonance
chapters.lore: Build a dimension that holds Earthly embodiment and possible soul-presences in other realms together. Its bridges represent coexistence rather than escape or compulsory travel. Different beliefs are welcome: no human must claim a soul-home to have a place in creation.
chapters.title: 107 / Build Embodied Soul Dimension

generators.name: Daughter Universe

generators.desc: The time fairy tends histories that could have unfolded differently.
generators.name: Branching Timeline Tree

generators.desc: A weaving fairy joins many universes into a family of possibilities.
generators.name: Multiverse Loom

generators.desc: Build a dimension where different universes may sustain different rules. Omnielle hears a chorus that no single lawbook can contain.
generators.name: Possible Laws Dimension

generators.desc: Omnielle hears no final universe beyond the next: existence holds infinitely many worlds, not a row of spheres waiting at distant coordinates.
generators.name: A Chorus Without Last World

generators.desc: Worlds overlap as distinct possibilities in the confluence. In this fantasy, sharing a presence does not force them into one history or one material place.
generators.name: Superposed Universes

generators.desc: One world counts ages, another circles its moments, another has no succession. Omnielle cannot ask which universe is first without choosing a local clock.
generators.name: A Thousand Incompatible Nows

generators.desc: Universes are not neighboring rooms in a larger space. Near and far belong to each world; their confluence needs no shared map and no journey through the gap.
generators.name: Where Distance Has No Common Meaning

resident_friends.name: Lady Aporielle
resident_friends.home: Where Distance Has No Common Meaning

generators.desc: A law can hold faithfully within one universe and have no meaning in another. Their meeting is not permission to break local rules; it is the absence of one universal rulebook.
generators.name: Laws That Need Not Agree

generators.desc: Omnielle teaches the fairies to answer a shared motif without measuring a route or synchronized moment. This is a fictional relationship, not a claim of faster-than-light signaling.
generators.name: Resonance Without Travel

generators.desc: Recognition does not select one universe and erase the rest. Worlds remain distinct possibilities held together; no single observer owns their existence.
generators.name: The Uncollapsed Garden

generators.desc: The fairies prepare Omnielle's foundation: connection without conquest, coexistence without sameness, and care for lives whose worlds may never share a sky.
generators.name: Concord Without Erasure

generators.desc: Omnielle builds a confluence of infinitely many superposed universes. No shared clock, common distance, or single causal law governs their meeting. She shelters their relationships without collapsing their differences; every living world retains its own story.
generators.name: Omniverse Confluence Dimension

generators.desc: A fairy nurtures a way existence can unfold: neither a command nor a superior realm, but one living principle.
generators.name: First Dao Seed

generators.desc: Ways of growth, stillness, dream, sound, renewal, and countless other principles blossom as distinct potential dimensions.
generators.name: Garden of Innumerable Ways

generators.desc: The ways learn to coexist without becoming identical. Each dimension may be woven before or after another in a different creation sequence.
generators.name: Concord of Different Ways

generators.desc: Build an interwoven family of three thousand Dao-like dimensions. In this original fantasy, the name evokes abundant ways of existence, not a canonical list of spiritual teachings.
generators.name: Three Thousand Dao Dimensions

generators.desc: Build a dimension that lets possible worlds become actual. Reality rests on many interwoven dimensions; later foundations can support earlier creations.
generators.name: Reality Dimension

generators.desc: In this story, every living seed carries the whole divine nature, still unrecognized. Life did not lack divinity; it lacked awareness of its depth.
generators.name: Memory in Every Seed

generators.desc: A thousand lives seem separate, yet their fairy hears one breath expressed through many voices.
generators.name: One Breath, Many Lives

generators.desc: The fairy of witnessing turns inward: the one who observes is also part of what is observed.
generators.name: The Inner Witness

generators.desc: Build the dimension of perception. Local senses are a viewpoint, not the boundary of life; the whole was never absent.
generators.name: Perception Dimension

generators.desc: All-seeing is not surveillance from above. The life within every viewpoint recognizes its shared sight.
generators.name: All-Seeing Awareness

generators.desc: Before the journey between two places, the same living presence is already at both ends.
generators.name: Presence Without Distance

generators.desc: The fairy of nearness loosens the imagined border between a life and the reality it inhabits.
generators.name: Everywhere Is Within

generators.desc: Life recognizes itself throughout existence. It has not traveled everywhere; in this fantasy, separation was the veil.
generators.name: Omnipresence Recognized

generators.desc: Creative will awakens as care, not domination. To be powerful is to make room for another beginning.
generators.name: Will That Nurtures

generators.desc: Life can imagine beyond the laws of a single reality. Possibility becomes an open garden.
generators.name: The Unbounded Possible

generators.desc: Ultimate creative power is recognized as life's own nature. In the game's myth, it was latent in the smallest seed.
generators.name: Omnipotence Recognized

generators.desc: Build a dimension uniting all-seeing understanding, omnipresence, and creative power. Recognition reveals life's latent nature rather than granting it from outside.
generators.name: Divine Awareness Dimension

generators.desc: Unity does not erase anyone. The fairy of compassion protects every distinct voice within the shared life.
generators.name: The Whole That Cherishes Each

generators.desc: The life of the first ocean recognizes the same nature as the ultimate goddess: presence, awareness, and creative power.
generators.name: Life and Ultimate Divinity

generators.desc: Omniall names the story's revelation: all-present, all-seeing, all-capable life, once hidden from its own perception.
generators.name: Omniall: Life Recognizes Itself

generators.desc: Build a dimension where life recognizes its shared ultimate nature. The first hope already held the whole; every distinct life remains worthy of care.
generators.name: Living Divinity Dimension

generators.desc: Beyond recognized divinity, new peoples seek a home. Angelic life awakens as luminous winged beings, each free to choose a calling rather than obey a predetermined virtue.
generators.name: Wings of the First Welcome

generators.desc: The angelic choirs weave healing gardens, cloudborne homes, and a covenant of refuge. Their light offers shelter, never a demand for worship.
generators.name: The Sanctuary Choir

generators.desc: Build the Angel Realm, a living dimension of luminous cities and open sanctuaries. Its people sustain their own seasons, friendships, and disagreements; radiance does not make them infallible.
generators.name: Angel Realm

generators.desc: Demonic life kindles in the warm depths between dimensions. Horned artisans and ember spirits discover that fierce feeling can become creation rather than conquest.
generators.name: Embers That Choose

generators.desc: Forge an accord that binds promises only by willing consent. Demonic communities build hearths, foundries, and schools of transformation; no ancestry determines a life's goodness.
generators.name: The Freeflame Accord

generators.desc: Build the Demon Realm, where obsidian gardens and ember rivers sustain passionate, self-governing peoples. Strength protects the freedom to change, including the freedom to lay power down.
generators.name: Demon Realm

generators.desc: Elves awaken within patient world-trees while fairies emerge among wandering blossoms. Different lifespans and scales of life invite listening rather than hierarchy.
generators.name: Roots and Gossamer

generators.desc: Elven groves and fairy courts share seed libraries, moonlit paths, and a promise to restore what they harvest. Neither people owns the living forest.
generators.name: The Bloomroot Covenant

generators.desc: Build the Elves and Fairies Realm: a dimension of world-tree cities, petal villages, and rivers of renewing magic. Its many courts preserve wild places and welcome lives unlike their own.
generators.name: Elves and Fairies Realm

generators.desc: Distinct gods awaken as stewards of tides, thresholds, memory, and beginnings. They share life's recognized divine nature; their calling is responsibility, not greater worth than other beings.
generators.name: Keepers of Many Callings

generators.desc: The pantheon establishes a council where even the smallest life may question a god. Worship is optional; care, accountability, and room for differing traditions sustain their gathering.
generators.name: The Listening Pantheon

generators.desc: Build the Gods Realm, a dimension of starborne halls and gardens of living archetypes. Its gods tend connections among worlds without claiming ownership of the lives within them.
generators.name: Gods Realm

generators.desc: In places unlit by other realms, shadow-born people awaken with senses tuned to hush, contrast, and hidden paths. Darkness is their habitat, not a moral sentence.
generators.name: Lives Beyond the Lantern

generators.desc: The shadow courts protect rest, privacy, and memories not ready for daylight. Their lanterns guide invited travelers; a secret may shelter a life without imprisoning it.
generators.name: The Quiet Lantern Pact

generators.desc: Build the Shadow Realm, where velvet forests and dusk seas nurture life beyond the glare. Its borders offer refuge and chosen passage, never compulsory forgetting.
generators.name: Shadow Realm

generators.desc: Angelic, demonic, elven, fairy, divine, and shadow-born envoys meet as equals. Five realms contain many peoples; no envoy can speak for every life in a homeland.
generators.name: Five Realms, Many Voices

generators.desc: Weave invited crossings among the five living realms. Local rhythms and laws remain distinct; travelers adapt through shared care rather than forcing every home into one pattern.
generators.name: Thresholds of Welcome

generators.desc: Build a dimension of relationship among the Angel, Demon, Elves and Fairies, Gods, and Shadow realms. Their homes remain sovereign and alive: unity protects difference rather than erasing it.
generators.name: Concord of Living Realms Dimension

generators.desc: Across every realm, joy welcomes another beginning. In this myth, blooming gardens and gathering stars echo life's delight; no one must feel happy to deserve belonging. Claim this chapter to unlock Happy.
generators.name: Joy: Creation in Bloom

generators.desc: Oceans receive the rain as communities hold grief. Sorrow honors what mattered without demanding an ending to mourning. Creation makes room for absence as well as arrival. Claim to unlock Sorrow.
generators.name: Sorrow: What Love Remembers

generators.desc: A child of any realm may look upward and ask why. Wonder links the first uncertain spark to every unexplored sky; this is poetic resonance, not a physical force. Claim to unlock Surprised.
generators.name: Wonder: The Unopened Sky

generators.desc: A shy glance can become a bridge between strangers. Tenderness protects vulnerability across angelic choirs, shadow courts, and fairy groves without requiring anyone to reveal more than they wish. Claim to unlock Shy.
generators.name: Tenderness: The Trust to Be Seen

resident_friends.name: Lady Pudorielle
resident_friends.home: Tenderness: The Trust to Be Seen

generators.desc: Fear listens for danger; courage chooses a caring step beside it. Like a seed opening in uncertain soil, every realm learns that bravery need not silence trembling. Claim to unlock Courage.
generators.name: Courage: A Light Beside Fear

generators.desc: Anger signals a boundary crossed. The realms learn to turn its heat toward protection and repair, never cruelty; a feeling is not a command to harm. Claim to unlock Anger.
generators.name: Anger: The Boundary Flame

generators.desc: No life has to feel exactly what another feels to offer care. Compassion carries help between incompatible worlds, linking creation through chosen acts rather than erasing anyone's experience. Claim to unlock Compassion.
generators.name: Compassion: No Heart Outside

generators.desc: Stillness is not the disappearance of sorrow, anger, or joy. Like a quiet sky holding changing weather, serenity gives every feeling room without surrendering care. Claim to unlock Serenity.
generators.name: Serenity: A Place for Every Feeling

resident_friends.name: Lady Quieselle
resident_friends.home: Serenity: A Place for Every Feeling

generators.desc: The five realms gather in rhythms that need not agree. Their dance celebrates a creation spacious enough for delight, grief, fear, and hope together; participation is always a choice. Claim to unlock Dance.
generators.name: Celebration: The Many-Hearted Dance

generators.desc: Build a dimension of emotional relationship throughout creation. It holds the possibility of understanding, not one compulsory mood or a shared mind. Each heart keeps its freedom; every feeling may be heard.
generators.name: Universal Heart Dimension

generators.desc: On planet Earth, humans live through bodies, families, communities, and changing seasons. This fictional saga imagines that a soul might also reside in another realm at the same time; earthly life remains fully real and worthy of care.
generators.name: Human Life on Earth

generators.desc: In this game's myth, an embodied human may have a soul-presence elsewhere without departing Earth. Two homes can coexist in one life: this is simultaneous presence, not death, reincarnation, or a scientific claim about consciousness.
generators.name: One Life, More Than One Presence

resident_friends.name: Lady Animielle
resident_friends.home: One Life, More Than One Presence

generators.desc: Imagine a person tending an Earth garden while their soul also resides among the Angel Realm's luminous gardens. Neither presence replaces the other; an angelic connection grants no authority over another person's choices or worth.
generators.name: Earthly Life, Angelic Home

generators.desc: Other human stories imagine soul-presences in the Demon, Elves and Fairies, Gods, or Shadow realms, perhaps in more than one at once. No realm determines a human's morality, rank, or destiny, and not every person shares this belief.
generators.name: Souls Across Living Realms

generators.desc: A human may interpret dreams, imagination, or quiet reflection as symbols of connection within this story, never as proof of another realm. Food, rest, friendship, and responsibility on Earth remain important; nobody must leave or neglect their body to belong.
generators.name: Rooted Here, Connected Beyond

generators.desc: Build a dimension that holds Earthly embodiment and possible soul-presences in other realms together. Its bridges represent coexistence rather than escape or compulsory travel. Different beliefs are welcome: no human must claim a soul-home to have a place in creation.
generators.name: Embodied Soul Dimension
